heroStages.headline: Specialist-led Retina & Cataract Eye Care
heroStages.description: Expert evaluation and personalised eye care for retina, cataract, diabetic eye disease, ROP and comprehensive ophthalmology in a serene, modern clinical setting.
heroStages.subDetail: Equipped for delicate microsurgery and comprehensive medical retina management.

heroStages.headline: Optical Clarity & Cornea
heroStages.description: The eye's natural crystalline protective front surface. Clear light refraction is vital for high-resolution visual acuity.
heroStages.subDetail: Diagnostic topography and optical biometry for customized visual restoration.

heroStages.headline: Crystalline Lens & Cataract
heroStages.description: Precision-focused cataract care with micro-incision phacoemulsification and advanced customized premium intraocular lens implantation.
heroStages.subDetail: Day-care stitchless surgery with rapid visual recovery.

heroStages.headline: Vitreous Cavity & Floatage
heroStages.description: Specialized vitrectomy care for vitreous hemorrhages, floaters, diabetic traction and complex posterior segment trauma.
heroStages.subDetail: Ultra-high speed sutureless micro-incision vitrectomy surgery (MIVS).

heroStages.headline: Retina, Macula & Central Vision
heroStages.description: The delicate neural tapestry of vision. Expert treatment for retinal detachments, diabetic macular edema, AMD and vein occlusions.
heroStages.subDetail: Sub-micron optical coherence tomography (OCT) and targeted anti-VEGF injections.

heroStages.headline: Optic Nerve & Ocular Health
heroStages.description: Direct conduit to visual perception. Comprehensive screening for glaucoma, ischemic neuropathies, and systemic vascular changes.
heroStages.subDetail: Holistic ophthalmic protection for lifelong sight.

technology.title: Microsurgical Technology & Aseptic OT
technology.description: Delicate ophthalmic structures demand sub-micron imaging and precision fluidics to maximize patient visual recovery.

items.title: 25G / 27G Sutureless Vitrectomy
items.desc: High-speed pneumatic cut rates with micro-cannulas for retinal detachment repair, macular holes, and diabetic vitreous hemorrhage with rapid healing.

items.title: Carl Zeiss Optics & Spectral OCT
items.desc: Stereoscopic high-depth red reflex visualization and micron-level optical coherence tomography for early detection of retinal disorders.

items.title: Class 100 HEPA Clean Air OT
items.desc: Modular positive-pressure laminar airflow with 99.97% bacterial air filtration for ultra-sterile microsurgical safety and zero endophthalmitis.
